maria: done. added:
```
./scripts/smoke --env=staging --concurrency=10 --requests=200
```
Also put the smoke checklist under "test plan".

sam: perfect, I'll queue the smoke run once canary is reserved.

@jen: can you reserve the canary slot for 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC? that time works for me to watch.
